_note: Draft, unreviewed: a native reviewer confirms every term (TSA-028).
scope: Claim phrases from the English RULES in site/src/lib/claims.ts, for translated guides in site/src/content/guides-i18n/<code>/. Scanned by site/scripts/check-claims-i18n.mjs. Report only: nothing here is a verdict on a translation.
selection: Languages are the five with the most translated guides (many locales tie at 116 files; the first five in alphabetical order are ar, bn, cs, da, de) plus es and fr, which the brief adds.
basisRule: A form is listed only when a file in the repository uses it for the same idea (the translated sentence that says Creative Activities is not therapy, not a treatment, or the translated explainer title). An empty forms list means no repository basis was found, not that no equivalent exists.
notCovered: dementia-sufferer (RULES): a wording rule, not a claim; no table yet.
review-badge (RULES): covered by the reviewer record rules (CNT-1004), not by vocabulary.
condition-title and skill-claim (RULES): context-dependent; not translated into a term list yet.

Therapeutic: the translated titles of therapeutic-art-activities-for-adults.md use a relaxing word in each language (ar مريحة, bn শান্তিদায়ক, cs Uvolňující, da Afslappende, de Entspannende, es relajantes, fr relaxantes). These are approved alternatives, not equivalents of the banned word, so no form is listed here.
